Make selection deterministic for these equal-clock numeric-alias ties using a stable raw revision identifier tie-break after the existing clocks and numeric-aware rank; preserve priority of later PIT-visible availability/observation, existing r9/r10 ordering, point_in_time_filter-before-revision contract, revision_key/source identity, context-only isolation, raw/provenance, and frozen scoring. Add deterministic regression in test_contracts_normalization.py that creates same-source/source_record_id/family/metric observations r1 and r01 with same clocks but different value/provenance and asserts identical winner and provenance under both input permutations; also retain r9/r10 PIT tests, numeric 1 vs 2 same-clock behavior, and separate record identities.
